description: Adds an email configuration to a burst and answers it: one email to its recipients with the variants it selects, every variant by default. Sends nothing. Only the burst's owner and admins may.

bcc.description: The addresses that also receive the email without the others seeing them.

cc.description: The addresses copied on the email, which every recipient can see.

emailAnalyticsEnabled.description: Whether opens of the email are tracked.

name.description: The configuration's name, as shown in the burst's Emailing tab in the app.

replyTo.description: Where replies to the email go.

sendAttachmentAsLink.description: Whether the email puts the `pdf` or `ppt` file behind a Download PDF or Download PPT button instead of attaching it. When `false`, the file is attached. Has no effect with `cloudLink`.

sharingFormat.description: How the email delivers the report. `pdf` and `ppt` send it as a PDF or PowerPoint file, attached or behind a download button (see `sendAttachmentAsLink`); a slide deck leaves its hidden slides out. `link` sends a link to the Google Drive or OneDrive file an older report updates, shared with the recipients as set in the app; an email report sends its content in the email itself, and a slide deck has no such file, so one whose settings still contain `link` is emailed as a PDF behind a download button. `cloudLink` (Exported link in the app), for slide decks only, sends a link to the copy exported to Google Drive or OneDrive and shares it with the addresses in `to`, `cc` and `bcc` with the sharing permission set in the app, viewer unless changed there; if no permission is set, as after PDF or PPT was picked in the app, the copy isn't shared with them.

smtpServerId.description: The SMTP connection the email is sent through, from `listSmtpConnections`; `null` sends from Rollstack's own address.

to.description: The addresses the email goes to.

variantIds.description: The variants the email includes, by their `id` in `listBurstVariants`. Empty includes every variant, also those added later.

zipAttachments.description: Whether the variants' files come in one zip file, with a file format.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

name: createBurstEmailConfig
title: Create burst email configuration
